itemList.description:
Conducting Topographical GIS survey for the proposed Water Supply / UGD scheme to the city / town with latest total station survey equipments. The work shall include collection of field data from local body, conducting detailed survey showing the all important land marks, land acquisition data, existing water supply lines, sewer lines, all roads, levels, nature of roads, L-section survey for transmission main/ feeders/sub-feeder/ rising main from Jack well to WTP and WTP to OHT’s and distribution network inlcuding clearing the obstructions, with all survey staff required covering all the developed & newly developed layouts or L-section survey for Sub-Main/Mains/Trunk Sewer/Rising main from wetwell to STP inlcuding clearing the obstructions, with all survey staff required covering all the developed & newly developed layouts with submission of Soft copy of drawings along with source file and Hard Copy in 3 sets for the following:
Sewer out fall pipe line

Conducting block level survey work for the proposed WTP, STP etc., with latest total station survey equipments. The work shall include collection of field data from local body, conducting detailed survey showing the all important land marks, existing water supply lines, sewer lines with submission of Soft copy of drawings along with source file and Hard Copy in 3 sets

Preparation of hydraulic design report including analysis, design for providing water supply distribution/UGD network to towns in Shimoga district & the job involves in analysis and hydraulic design using software programme incorporating requirements as per CPHEEO Norms and deisgn of distribution network in Water Gems software and UGD network by relevant software. The design report should include, design criteria and design sheet with full details such as node numbers, length of pipe, materials & class of pipe, Size of pipe, RLs of ground, pipe numbers, MH Nos, GL, TL & IL of MH and all other relevant data for WS and UGD design. The report should also contain tentative quantity of all items, statement of pipe diameters & required quantity of pipe specials etc., The population forecast, water demand & zonal boundary has to be provided by the board estimate to be prepared by the Board.
